title: wkfind.ps1 Investigation Tool
desc: Mandatory first step for every bug/regression diagnosis. Scans logs, errors.jsonl, suggest history with keyword + time-scope. DPI compensation built-in for multi-monitor pixel coord bugs.
steps: FIRST STEP for every bug/regression: wkfind.ps1 keyword [--day|--week|--month] -- scans logs + errors.jsonl + suggest history@@Time-scope ALWAYS: --day (24h default), --week (7d), --month (30d). Start narrow, widen only if nothing found@@DPI compensation: wkfind adjusts pixel coordinates for multi-monitor/scaling configs automatically -- do NOT pre-scale coords before passing@@Output: sorted by recency, deduplicated. Top match = start of investigation, not end@@next:errors-jsonl-triage cluster:wkfind-investigation-tool-ref
